activity.role: Poet and author of Eugene Onegin
activity.notes: The 1833 first complete edition of Eugene Onegin is one representative literary publication point under the Russian Empire, not the beginning or end of Pushkin's career. Earlier serial publication 1825–1832 and the 1837 revision are contextual. The author Alexander Sergeyevich Pushkin (1799–1837) is distinct from his namesake son, later namesakes, the city, and the character Eugene Onegin; Tchaikovsky's later opera is not Pushkin's Activity. Saint Petersburg is the publication context; Russian cultural affiliation does not imply continuous residence throughout composition.
